demande: A customer reports an unauthorized debit card transaction. How long does the bank have to investigate?
texte: Under Regulation E (12 CFR 1005.11(c)), a financial institution generally must investigate and determine whether an error occurred within 10 business days of receiving a notice of error. If the institution cannot complete its investigation within 10 business days, it may take up to 45 days from receipt of the notice of error, provided it provisionally credits the consumer's account in the amount of the alleged error. Furthermore, these time periods may be extended to 20 business days (in place of 10 business days) or 90 days (in place of 45 days) depending on specific circumstances such as point-of-sale or foreign transactions.
